summary: No concrete P0/P1 Swift compilation or consent-status defect established by static inspection. Native compilation, presentation/lifecycle and exact-message transport remain unverified; privacy manifest/domain disclosure is unresolved before submission.

observations.result: Keep consentStatus == required as equivalent to the documented UMP3.1 loadAndPresentIfRequired condition. No evidence establishes a bug solely because ATT is notDetermined while consentStatus is obtained; test that combination with real configured messages. Do not force presentation based only on formStatus.available.

Current Google GDPR FAQ states GDPR first then ATT on consent when both messages configured. The candidate does not manually derive ATT permission from canRequestAds and does not issue a separate unconditional ATT call.

Explicit true is necessary to reverse the previous persisted false for upgrading users. Applying configuration before start's already-started guard also refreshes policy after later choices. SDK regional/OS enforcement still requires runtime evidence; enabling the publisher-scoped option is not an unconditional grant to track.

AppTrackingTransparency linker flags present in app Debug and Release; usage description in Advertising.plist and localized EN/ES catalog. Verify compiled resources and native presentation; source presence alone does not prove compiled localization.

Candidate invalidates requests and refreshes consent on active scene unless UMP busy. This should cover return from tracking Settings; verify reentrancy around ATT/system sheets and no indefinite repeat/hidden modal. No confirmed race claimed from static review.

The exact API/case names exist in official Apple docs. Method iOS13.4+, resource userTracking iOS15+. Therefore minimum iOS16 compatible. Current migrated XCUIAutomation module metadata indicates Xcode16.3; actual compiler/toolchain remains to be verified.

Waits for either real SpringBoard Ask App Not to Track or UMP completion, records explicit non-certification if absent. Appropriate sample coverage limitation, but cannot substitute for a real ATT Allow test or custom configured Tarot message.

releaseIssues.detail: Application still declares NSPrivacyTracking=false while the candidate introduces optional IDFA cross-company tracking; inspected GMA12.14 manifest marks DeviceID tracking but lacks the top-level tracking/domain keys. Apple covers app or SDK tracking. Resolve actual tracking-domain requirements using SDK/transport evidence; false is not justified merely by collection occurring in the SDK. Do not set true with an empty array or fabricate broad Google hosts.

Publishing app-scoped IDFA messaging can affect already distributed 1.2 lacking its purpose key and promised identifier behavior. Leave remote message draft until exact legacy behavior/rollout and policy timing are demonstrated. Current source changes cannot fix an installed older binary.
No native execution/ATT Allow/real message transport/aggregate archive privacy report is established by this subtask. Do not label the candidate reviewed or compliant solely from static validators.

mutationsByThisSubtask: Only proposed JSON artifacts in docs/technical/consent-ad-preferences-20261029. No app, SDK, workflow, account, message, metadata or public policy mutations.
